Kitchen, meals & drinks

bite verb and noun

also last bite

classical

mordeō

verb, second conjugation

Second conjugation, so mordē.

Examples

  • Mordē! Nimis magnum est.

    Bite it! It’s too big.composed

  • Ūnum morsum etiam, deinde bellāria.

    One more bite, then dessert.composed

Other words

  • morsus, morsūs m. — a bite

    noun, fourth declension · also used · classical

    Lewis & Short leaves the o unmarked; nothing supports a long vowel.

See also eat up.

SourcesLewis & Short: mordeo · Lewis & Short: morsus
